summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of IHEZA School Management System focusing on Report Cards and Fees Management features. All requested features are working correctly.
passed_tests: Report Cards page loads with class and term selection
Class dropdown shows options: Select Class, Grade 1A, Grade 1B, Grade 2A, Grade 3A
Term dropdown shows: Term 1, Term 2, Term 3, Final
Academic Year input shows current year (2026)
Student dropdown shows names with access codes (e.g., Ali Hassan - DUP/STU0001/2026)
Student search functionality works
Behavior marks can be edited (1-5 scale) - Neatness, Cooperation, Responsibility, Punctuality, Discipline
Behavior marks display as star ratings in report card preview
Teacher's Comment textarea works
Principal's Comment textarea works
Report card preview shows in one-page format with IHEZA header
Report card shows student info: Name, Admission No, Class, Position
Report card shows grades table (Subject, Score, Grade, Remarks)
Report card shows summary stats (Subjects, Total Score, Average, Overall Grade)
Report card shows BEHAVIOR & CONDUCT section with star ratings
Report card shows COMMENTS section
Report card shows signature lines (Class Teacher, Principal, Parent/Guardian)
Save button works - shows 'Report card saved' toast
Print button visible and functional
Send to Student button appears after saving
Fees Management page loads with three tabs
Fee Structures tab shows Add Fee button for Secretary
Add Fee modal shows: Fee Name, Amount (TZS), School Chain, Class (Optional), Description
Payments tab shows student search
Payments tab shows student list with names and access codes
Financial Reports tab shows collection stats (Total Students, Expected Revenue, Collected, Outstanding)
Financial Reports tab shows Collection Rate with progress bar
Export CSV button visible in Financial Reports
critical_code_review_comments: Report Cards implementation is well-structured with proper state management
Behavior marks use 1-5 scale with star display in preview
Print functionality uses window.open with custom CSS for one-page layout
Fees Management uses tabs for Fee Structures, Payments, and Financial Reports
Role-based access control properly restricts Add Fee button to Secretary role
Student dropdown correctly displays both name and access code format
context_for_next_testing_agent: Report Cards and Fees Management features are fully functional. Report Cards allows teachers to select class/term, view students with access codes, edit behavior marks (1-5), add comments, save, print, and send to student portal. Fees Management allows secretaries to manage fee structures, record payments, and view financial reports with collection rates.
